tests.name: a. cardiac event: detected, patient confirms, hospital search starts, hospital accepts, family sees it
b. manual SOS: patient taps SOS and the search starts at once, with a location
c. "I'm okay" inside the countdown: needs a reason, cancels, nobody is notified
d. nobody answers: help is sent automatically after the countdown and contacts are alerted
e. nobody accepts: the search widens 10 -> 20 -> 30 km, then the case is unresolved and admin is told
f. reload in the middle of the countdown: the server clock decides, the countdown continues
g. server restarts during the countdown: the case is resumed and still sent on time, no duplicate
h. two tabs press "Send help now" together: one case, one hospital search, one alert per contact
F1. a Level 3 alert arrives while nobody has touched the page: no console errors, banner still shows
F2. the backend goes away during the countdown: the page stays usable, 112 stays visible, and it recovers
F3. "Send help now" fails with a server error: the patient sees an error and can still call 112
F4. a second SOS while one is open does not open a second case
F5. a family link that is wrong or made up shows "not valid" and leaks nothing
F6. hospital accepts and the patient cancels at the same moment: exactly one final state, consistent everywhere
F7. presenter key is enforced when set: no key means no scenario change
F8. the patient has no allergy record: first aid never suggests aspirin (missing means hidden)
